highLevelGoal: Finish Orca-Strator's documented V1 scope truthfully: crash-safe unattended execution (durable actor/process ownership, atomic replayable transitions, abortable lifecycle) certified by every gate an available host can actually run, with the remaining evidence enumerated as host-bound or authorization-bound rather than filed as a blanket external blocker.

checkpoint.summary: 2026-08-28 continuation session, from f63ddf0 on branch claude/complete-entire-thing-n7u6i9 (operator-named session branch; the repository default of direct-to-main is unchanged and nothing was force-pushed). Ran the fast tier on a non-Windows host and then, for the FIRST TIME, the complete 15-suite real-process tier in one process. That run found FOUR CRITICAL DEFECTS the fast tier structurally cannot see, three of them introduced by Change 028 itself: (1) deliverOutboxEffect had no START_EXECUTION_ACTOR branch, so every autonomous turn consumed its dispatch and never started an executor; (2) onStrategyCompleted read 'dispatch consumed' as 'already applied', so every SWARM/DAG completion was swallowed after workers had already published to the remote; (3) completePostflightRetry and retryPendingPostflight used the same stale inference, so postflight recovery could never find a candidate; (4) the retry recorded no durable transition, so it was not idempotent. Also fixed three High host-flavour defects (win32 path composition in chrome-discovery, POSIX basename in executorIdentityMatches, zombie handling in PortableProcessProbe). Change 028 is now complete: 125/125 tasks, three delta specs folded into openspec/specs/, archived as 2026-08-28-028-*. Changes 026/027 reconciled and DELIBERATELY left unarchived; Change 029 at 103/110 with the seven open items annotated host-bound or authorization-bound.
